description: This file defines the class ADODB_pdo_mssql, a driver class for integrating Microsoft SQL Server with the ADODB database abstraction layer using PDO. It provides methods for server info, limiting query results, transaction modes, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_mssql
classes.description: A driver class for Microsoft SQL Server using PDO within the ADODB abstraction layer, providing functionality for server info, query limiting, transaction modes, and metadata.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting transaction support and input array binding behavior, noting a bug in PDO MSSQL driver.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server information via the ADOConnection class.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset parameters, wrapping ADOConnection's SelectLimit method.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation level for the database session.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Returns false, indicating metadata retrieval for tables is unsupported.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns false, indicating metadata retrieval for columns is unsupported.
